def test_put_get():
    c = LRUCache(2)
    c.put("a", 1)
    assert c.get("a") == 1

    assert c.get("zzz") is None

    c.put("a", 1)
    c.put("b", 2)
    c.put("c", 3)

    assert c.get("c") == 3
